checks.sentence: The FY2014 operating cash outflow of ₹349.75 lakh occurred while the company was also reporting a modest PAT loss — meaning working capital was consuming cash beyond the operating loss.
The FY2015 cash inflow of ₹802.59 lakh is the strongest in the series, coinciding with the turnaround year.
